data.name: Ark
data.gender_notes: Ark is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ark has its origins in the Hindu religion and language. It is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi words 'Arka' which means 'the Sun' or 'a boat'. The name symbolizes the idea of new beginnings and light, as the sun rises each day to bring new life and illuminate the world. In Hindu mythology, the god Surya is often depicted as riding a chariot pulled by seven horses, and the name Ark can also be associated with the idea of a boat, as in the biblical story of Noah's Ark, which symbolizes the journey to a new beginning.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ark is a spiritual name that represents the idea of new beginnings and light. In Hinduism, the sun is a powerful symbol of creation and renewal, and the name Ark can be seen as a reminder of the divine light that shines within us and guides us on our journey through life. The name can also be associated with the idea of a boat or vessel, which can symbolize the journey of the soul through life and the various challenges and experiences that we encounter along the way.
data.etymology: Ark belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Sun or Boat.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ark total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
